thread:
lee: Noticed mismatch between dashboard p95 and endpoint breakdown for /v1/chat. Dashboard p95=95ms, eu-central endpoint p95=210ms.
anya: What's the sample_count? small slices + t-digest = surprises.
lee: Top-level shows 24.2k, eu-central slice shows 640.
quentin: Dumped quick query:
select region, sample_count, p50, p95 from latency_rollups where route='/v1/chat' and ts between 1721054200 and 1721054320;
-- global 24200 48 95
-- eu-central 640 50 210
anya: Check routing events; we had a short period where routing policy diverted traffic to fallback-quantized due to quota headroom.
monitor-bot: routing: fallback event tenant=acme corp route=/v1/chat at=1721054283 reason=quota_burst fallback=cpu-slow-1
lee: That explains local tail. Product folks see global p95 and assume fine. We need UX clarity.
anya: Quick UX fixes: 1) show sample_count next to percentiles on top card, 2) mark card with a "slice-skew" indicator when single slice contributes >45% of tail, 3) chart annotation for routing fallback events.
quentin: Infra suggestion: for comparisons, avoid merging t-digests from slices with sample_count < 1500; instead compute percentiles from raw samples for those slices. I'll open INFRA-4310.
lee: Priorities: badge+tooltip this sprint, infra ticket for raw-sample fallback.
anya: I'll draft tooltip copy noting t-digest merge caveat + link to runbook.
quentin: INFRA-4310 filed. Will add tests and an alert when a slice used in SLO has sample_count below threshold.
monitor-bot: deploy: console PR #870 canary 15% in 5m (adds sample_count badge + fallback annotation hook).
lee: Thanks everyone. Follow-up at 1721054500 to verify post-deploy numbers and update runbook.
